pred_ddx.label: Other neoplastic causes of precocious puberty and lytic bone lesions

McCune-Albright syndrome: The patient presents with the classic triad of McCune-Albright syndrome: precocious puberty (vaginal bleeding and breast enlargement), café-au-lait skin pigmentation (hyperpigmented patches), and fibrous dysplasia (lytic bone lesions).
Other neoplastic causes of precocious pu: Although less likely given the specific combination of symptoms, other neoplastic conditions could potentially cause precocious puberty and lytic bone lesions, but the presence of café-au-lait spots strongly points towards McCune-Albright syndrome.
